items.description: Electrician labour checking and rewiring flooded basement circuits, 12 hrs
items.rationale: Surface rainwater flooding is inundation, a further natural hazard under 2.1(c2). Nothing shows that group was taken, so the 3.6 bar removes all labour under 3.6.2(b). If it were covered, 12 h × ~75 = 900.
Every journey charge is barred under 3.6.2(f) because the inundation peril is not recorded. If covered, this would be the one journey charge allowed under 7.1.7(g), at about 79.
This is working equipment, which is not insured property (4.3(d)) and is not separately indemnified alongside the measure (5.2.2, 7.1.8(b)). The claim is also barred under 3.6.
Working equipment (4.3(d), 5.2.2), and it duplicates the procurement in line 3. The 3.6 bar also applies.

items.description: Water extraction from the flooded basement
items.rationale: Removal of standing water is a measure expressly barred under 3.6.2(d) when the inundation peril is uninsured. If covered, it would be a 5.2.2 measure at about 600.
Materials are barred under 3.6.2(c). If covered, roughly 80 for small materials built into the work.

items.description: Renew boiler incl. flue gas system and storage tank
items.rationale: Replacement of building plant is barred under 3.6.2(a): the damage is inundation from flooding and no (c2) cover is shown. If covered, roughly 12,000 for a like-for-like gas boiler with flue and tank, installed.

items.description: Adjust supply pipework to fit replacement boiler
items.rationale: Adaptation work belonging to a replacement is barred under 3.6.2(a). If covered under 7.1.7(d), about 900.
Disposal is barred under 3.6.2(e). If covered, about 400.
Barred under 3.6.2(f). Even if the claim were covered, this is a second journey charge for the same event and is excluded by 7.1.8(d).
